name: Ritewake Herald
rationale: A midscale herald turns each cast event into a waking signal that readies the whole company.

name: Spellglow Banneret
rationale: This character carries the surge of event magic outward, briefly brightening every ally's force.

name: Candlepath Recruiter
rationale: On arrival, a modest guide follows a small light toward an unassuming ally with low spark.

name: Read the Tidemarks
rationale: A low-cost omen-reading lets the player name the shape of the moment and find an event at that scale.

name: Voidwake Custodian
rationale: A careful keeper teaches the dead to return without being lost again to banishment.

name: Cinderhand Skirmisher
rationale: A lean Warrior turns discarded resources into immediate action, fighting from the ash of spent plans.

name: Dawnwaste Salvager
rationale: A Survivor spends themself to recover a lost event, then keeps sifting the deck into the void each dawn.

name: Veiled Cradle Tender
rationale: A small protected caretaker wakes early and trades a card to gather fragile characters back from the void.
